'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[M23 offensive (2022–present)|M23 offensive]]
***[[2025 Goma offensive]]
****[[March 23 Movement|M23]] rebels solidify control of [[Goma]], [[North Kivu Province]], and are confirmed to be holding captured [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese troops]] and allied [[Wazalendo]] militants at the [[Stade de l'Unité]]. They also begin advancing on [[Bukavu]], capital of the [[South Kivu|South Kivu Province]], according to senior [[Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese]] officials and a [[Rwanda]]n diplomat. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/1/29/dr-congo-live-news-rwanda-backed-m23-rebels-tighten-grip-on-goma (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/rwandas-kagame-says-he-agrees-with-us-need-ceasefire-congo-2025-01-29/ (Reuters)]
****In an emergency address to the nation, [[President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese president]] [[Félix Tshisekedi]] calls for calm and says "a vigorous and coordinated response against these terrorists and their sponsors is underway" by the armed forces, and also cancels participation in a regional summit with [[List of presidents of Rwanda|Rwandan president]] [[Paul Kagame]]. [https://foreignpolicy.com/2025/01/29/congo-rwanda-m23-rebels-goma-tshisekedi-kagame/ (''Foreign Policy'')] [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2025/01/30/dr-congo-president-says-army-mounting-vigorous-response-to-m23-advance_6737579_4.html (''Le Monde'')]
***Around 280 [[Romanians|Romanian]] [[mercenary|mercenaries]] fighting alongside the Congolese military in [[North Kivu]] surrender to the M23, according to the [[Rwandan Defence Force|Rwandan military]]. They are now being transported to [[Kigali]] after being handed over to Rwandan authorities. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cd0j4d7v229o (BBC News)]
*[[War against the Islamic State]]
**[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|War in Somalia]]
***[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
****[[Puntland]] authorities deport around a thousand undocumented [[Ethiopians]] from the cities of [[Bosaso]], [[Galkayo]], [[Qardho]], and the state’s capital, [[Garoowe]], as part of an ongoing crackdown on foreigners without legal status, following the discovery of foreign fighters acting as [[Islamic State]] recruiters in the [[Cal Miskaad]] mountains of the [[Bari Region]]. [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Jan/200008/puntland_deports_hundreds_of_undocumented_ethiopians_over_isis_recruitment_concerns.aspx (Hiiraan Online)] [https://www.idilnews.com/puntland-oo-dib-ugu-celisay-dalkooda-boqolaal-itoobiyaan-ah/ (Idil News)] [https://horseedmedia.net/puntland-oo-masaafurisay-boqolaal-ajaaniib-ah-oo-sharci-darro-ku-joogay-deegaanadeeda/399908/ (Horseed Media)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire|2025 Gaza war ceasefire]]
***[[U.S.]] [[Middle East]] Envoy [[Steve Witkoff]] visits the [[Gaza Strip]] and meets with [[Israel]]i [[Prime Minister of Israel|prime minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] to assure that the [[ceasefire]] remains intact. [https://www.npr.org/2025/01/29/nx-s1-5279178/us-mideast-envoy-steve-witkoff-gaza-israel-netanyahu (NPR)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Battle of Chasiv Yar]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] capture the city of [[Chasiv Yar]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]], after a year of intense fighting for control of the [[front line]] city. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2025/01/29/chasiv-yar-falls-to-russian-forces-after-nearly-a-year-of-intense-fighting-a87781 (''The Moscow Times'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Expansion of Heathrow Airport]]
**[[United Kingdom|UK]] [[Chancellor of the Exchequer]] [[Rachel Reeves]] approves the construction of a third [[runway]] at [[Greater London]]'s [[Heathrow Airport]] after decades of delays. [https://news.sky.com/story/chancellor-rachel-reeves-announces-backing-for-third-heathrow-runway-13298590 (Sky News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Prayag Kumbh Mela]]
**[[2025 Prayag Maha Kumbh Mela crowd crush]]
***At least 30 people are killed in a [[crowd crush]] at a [[Hinduism|Hindu]] festival in [[Prayagraj]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], [[India]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/cgq07z0yexvt (BBC News)]
*[[2025 Light Air Services Beechcraft 1900 crash]]
**A [[Beechcraft 1900|Beechcraft 1900D]] carrying employees of an [[Petroleum industry|oil company]] crashes in [[Unity (state)|Unity]], [[South Sudan]], killing 20 of the 21 people onboard, including one [[India]]n and two [[China|Chinese]] nationals. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/01/29/africa/south-sudan-plane-crash-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/plane-crash-south-sudans-unity-state-kills-18-uns-radio-miraya-reports-2025-01-29/ (Reuters)]
*[[2025 Potomac River mid-air collision]]
**A [[PSA Airlines]] [[Bombardier CRJ-700]] operating as [[American Eagle (airline brand)|American Eagle]] Flight 5342 collides with a [[United States Army|U.S. Army]] [[Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk]] over the [[Potomac River]] near [[Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport|Reagan National Airport]] in [[Washington, D.C.]], [[United States]], killing 67 people between both aircraft and causing a shutdown of flights in and out of the airport, leaving no survivors. [https://www.wusa9.com/article/travel/all-flights-halted-at-reagan-national-airport-due-to-plane-crash-potomac-river-dc/65-e2090f2d-0bca-4a4c-944c-215a6398a52d (WUSA-9)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/live-blog/live-updates-plane-crashes-potomac-river-collision-helicopter-reagan-n-rcna189942 (NBC NEWS)]
*Thirteen [[Artisanal mining|artisanal miners]], including three children, are killed when a tunnel at a [[gold mine]] floods after a reservoir spill in [[Kangaba Cercle|Kangaba]], [[Koulikoro Region|Koulikoro]], [[Mali]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/mali-gold-mine-accident-kills-more-than-dozen-including-women-children-2025-02-01/ (Reuters)]
*Five people, four from [[Norway]] and one from [[Switzerland]], are killed in two separate avalanches while [[off-piste skiing]] in the [[French Alps]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/czep67j3w8do (BBC)]
*A [[Venezuela]]n [[Ministry of Interior, Justice and Peace (Venezuela)|Ministry of Interior, Justice and Peace]] [[Cessna Citation II]] aircraft crashes shortly after takeoff from [[Generalissimo Francisco de Miranda Air Base]] in [[Caracas]], Venezuela, killing all three people on board. [https://caraotadigital.net/venezuela/avioneta-se-estrello-en-el-sector-el-volcan-en-el-hatillo-habia-despegado-desde-la-carlota/ (Caraota Digital)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[First 100 days of the second Donald Trump presidency]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] signs the [[Laken Riley Act]] into law, the first legislation of [[Second presidency of Donald Trump|Trump's second term]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/rcna188917 (NBC News)]

[https://www.dw.com/en/germany-psg-fans-arrested-champions-league/a-71443613 (DW)]
*Former [[U.S. Senator]] [[Bob Menendez]] of [[New Jersey]] is sentenced to 11 years in prison, following his conviction on [[bribery]] and [[corruption]] charges. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/clyekv226l2o (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Second presidency of Donald Trump]]
**[[2025 United States federal government grant pause]]
***The [[United States]] [[Office of Management and Budget]] rescinds a memo from Monday that would have paused [[Administration of federal assistance in the United States|federal financial assistance programs]] implicated by select [[executive orders]] of President Donald Trump, following a temporary block of the order on Tuesday by a [[Loren AliKhan|federal judge]]. Following the rescission, [[White House Press Secretary]] [[Karoline Leavitt]] states that the Trump administration will continue to pursue a freeze of federal funds. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cyv48540n4po (BBC News)]

**[[Ahmed al-Sharaa]] is declared the [[president of Syria]] during the [[First Syrian transitional government|transition period]], a month after [[Bashar al-Assad]] was [[Fall of the Assad regime|ousted]] by rebel forces. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syrias-leader-sharaa-named-president-transitional-period-state-news-agency-says-2025-01-29/ (Reuters)]
